about: Every public input the generalization matrix (scripts/corpus_matrix.py, docs/GENERALIZATION.md) runs the repository's tools against, plus public sources not yet added. local_path is relative to the repository root. committed=true means a clean clone has it; otherwise fetch is the command that builds or downloads it, and the matrix marks the cells 'needs data: <fetch>' until it is run. 'exercises' names the matrix rows the input feeds (1 tracer, 2 scorer controls, 3 intake + report, 4 loop audit, 5 exports, 6 historian bands, 7 DEXPI route, 8 pipe layer). Licenses of inputs are as stated in NOTICE.md; candidate licenses are copied from a license check done 2026-10-29 and are not legal advice. Inputs of kind needs_key (a sheet without a machine-readable key) or needs_confirmation (a pairing a person must confirm) get an n/a cell with the reason in 'not_scored' and are never scored. 'attribution' is the credit line to give when reusing the source; 'real' says whether the data were measured or drawn by people outside this repository (true) or simulated/synthetic (false).

candidates.tried_2026_10_29: pyDEXPI 1.2.0 installed in a throwaway environment (owner approved) and 10 synthetic files generated (data/external/pydexpi/synthetic, gitignored, MANIFEST.json). Its DEXPI writer outputs equipment and nozzles only: piping, valves, instruments, tags and connections built in memory are silently dropped. Usable to test a reader on equipment at scale; not for piping, instruments, tags or loop audits.
